# CollapsibleController

> Animates expand/collapse transitions on the host, dispatching `native:expand` and `native:collapse`.

## Constructor

```ts
new CollapsibleController(host: HTMLElement, options?: CollapsibleOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `duration` | `number` | no |  |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|----------|------|----------|
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | no |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:expand` | _(none)_ |
| `native:collapse` | _(none)_ |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `expand()` | `—` | `void` |
| `collapse()` | `—` | `void` |
| `toggle()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { CollapsibleController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new CollapsibleController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
